race.comment: Interesting way to start the day with a couple of first-starters looking to have good talent. Going with CORSAGE (7), a daughter of I Am Invincible who sports the Pinecliff colours, who showed her rivals a clean pair of heels in her latest jumpout. Wasn't knocked around, so there looked to be a bit more under the hood. Clinton McDonald always needs to be respected with his first-starters, even more so if there is market support, and it would not shock if there is support for WITH BENEFITS (11) who was a comfortable on-pace winner of her latest hitout. Drawn low looks a big plus for her. KOKESHI (4) has only placed once from six starts, but some of those were in better races than this, and comes here off a good second placing in a Cranbourne jumpout. HEGELY (3) ran some nice races last prep and has experience on her side.
